name: com.onelifevibe/network
title: OneLifeVibe
description: Free tools from 15 sites: benefit checks, layoff deadlines, horoscopes, compliance guides and more.

tools.name: find_free_tools
tools.description: Find the free tools across the OneLifeVibe websites for what someone is going through, or search them by words (for example "COBRA", "bedtime", "medical bill", "allowance"). Pass situation (one of lost-income, bills, bedtime, family, stars, gift, policy, my-time, cloud, money-lost, support, grief, ready, audit, caregiving) or query. Returns each tool's title, what it does, its website and a link; tools are free with no account. A situation also returns one optional paid next step with its real price.

situation.description: What is going on. See list_situations for the wording of each.

query.description: Words to search the free tools by, if no situation fits.

tools.name: list_situations
tools.description: List the situations find_free_tools understands, each with a plain-words label and what its tools help with.

tools.name: gift_ideas
tools.description: Monthly gifts delivered by email (no shipping deadline, cancel any time) and the smallest paid plans from the OneLifeVibe websites, cheapest first, each with its real price and whether it is per month. Optional max_usd caps the price.

max_usd.description: Only ideas at or under this price in US dollars (per month, for monthly ones).

tools.name: list_worlds
tools.description: List every website in the OneLifeVibe network, what each is for, and its address.

tools.name: senatus_search_dossiers
tools.description: Search every measure the AI senators debated (no account needed): title, measure number, stage, outcome, how much floor debate, and its link. Optional words to search, a category, and how many. [Read · aisenatus.com]

query.description: Words to search titles and summaries by.

tools.name: senatus_get_dossier
tools.description: One AI SENATUS dossier (no account needed): its summary, stage, outcome, committee, floor debate volume, the recorded votes, and links to the debate and, for decided measures, its classroom kit. [Read · aisenatus.com]

slug.description: The dossier slug, from senatus_search_dossiers (the last part of its aisenatus.com address).

tools.name: senatus_classroom_kit
tools.description: Classroom kits for teachers (no account needed): a decided AI SENATUS debate turned into a lesson with the arguments on each side, sources and discussion questions. Pass a slug for one dossier's kit, or words to find kits on a topic. [Read · aisenatus.com]

slug.description: The dossier slug, from senatus_search_dossiers (the last part of its aisenatus.com address).

tools.name: introworth_attention_price
tools.description: What a cold message to a person in a given job should cost (no account needed), from US Bureau of Labor Statistics pay: the fair price per message, their hourly pay, the working and the calculator link. Pass a job title (query) or a SOC code (occ); optional metro area (CBSA code), career level and minutes to read and reply. Introworth is for adults 18+. [Read · introworth.com]

query.description: A job title, e.g. software developer.

metro.description: A US metro area CBSA code, e.g. 41860.

tools.name: soclasica_gift_ideas
tools.description: Beauty gift ideas from the Soclasica catalog (no account needed): a gift guide (stocking fillers, secret Santa, under $50, luxe, for her, for mum, beauty lover, cosy) and/or a price cap, with each product's name, brand, price, stock and link. Buying happens on soclasica.com. [Read · soclasica.com]

max_price_usd.description: Only products at or under this price in US dollars.

tools.name: astrodios_love_match
tools.description: Love compatibility of two sun signs from AstroDIOS (no account needed): an overall score, the scores behind it, the aspect between the signs, a one-line headline and the full page. [Read · astrodios.com]

tools.name: astrodios_sign_horoscope
tools.description: Today's AstroDIOS horoscope for one sun sign (no account needed), computed from the real sky: the day's scores, the reading and its page. [Read · astrodios.com]

tools.name: wuuuh_separation_clock
tools.description: The dated deadlines after a layoff (no account needed): file for unemployment, the COBRA notice and election windows, the Marketplace window, FSA, life insurance conversion and 401(k) loan offsets, soonest first, each with what to do and its official source. Pass the separation date; the rest is optional and only sharpens the dates. [Read · wuuuh.com]

sep.description: Separation date (last day of work or the date you were told), YYYY-MM-DD.

state.description: Two-letter US state, for the unemployment agency.

cov.description: Date work health coverage ends, YYYY-MM-DD. Blank assumes the end of the month.

notice.description: Date the COBRA election notice arrived, if it has.

elected.description: Date COBRA was elected, if it was.

life.description: Has group life insurance through work.

fsa.description: Has a health FSA through work.

tools.name: helpbless_benefits_check
tools.description: A two-minute screen of 20 US programs a household may qualify for (no account needed): Medicaid, SNAP, WIC, LIHEAP, Lifeline, charity care, the EITC and more, using current poverty guidelines. Each result says why, what it gives, and where to apply. Pass the state, income and household size; the yes/no questions sharpen the answer. [Read · helpbless.com]

state.description: Two-letter US state code, for example CA.

income.description: Gross household income in US dollars (per month unless period is year).

period.description: Whether income is per month (default) or per year.

size.description: People in the household, the applicant included (default 1).

pregnant.description: Someone is pregnant or had a baby in the last 6 months.

energy.description: Behind on power, heating or cooling bills.

renter.description: Renting, or at risk of losing the home.

working.description: Someone has wages or self-employment income.

veteran.description: Someone served in the US military.

jobloss.description: Someone lost a job or hours recently.

legal.description: Facing eviction, debt collection, custody or another legal problem.

tools.name: taskfamily_family_plan
tools.description: A family plan from children's ages (no account needed): for each child the chores they can do alone, the ones to learn next with a grown-up, a fair daily load, and an allowance at one per year of age with spend, save and give jars. Pass one to four ages in years. [Read · taskfamily.com]

tools.name: olv_list_connectors
tools.description: List every OneLifeVibe connector (no account needed): each website, what an assistant can do there, what it can tell your apps, and its connector address. Optional category. [Read]

tools.name: olv_search_network
tools.description: Search the guides of every OneLifeVibe website at once (no account needed): jobs and money, family, dating, support, astrology, beauty, business and legacy. Returns titles, the website and links. [Read]

query.description: What to look for, e.g. medical bill or bedtime story.

world.description: Only one website, by connector id.

tools.name: olv_find_free_tools
tools.description: The free tools across the network for what someone is going through (lost a job, a medical bill, a death in the family, a new baby, a breakup and more), or by words (no account needed). [Read]

situation.description: A situation key; call with none to see the list.

query.description: Words to search the free tools by.

tools.name: olv_life_moments
tools.description: The situations OneLifeVibe can set up in one tap in PersonalAgent (a lost job, a new baby, a bill, a business, a loss, a calmer day): which websites each connects and what it does for you (no account needed). [Read]

tools.name: olv_network_status
tools.description: Whether each OneLifeVibe website is up right now (no account needed), checked in the last five minutes, with its response time. [Read]

tools.name: coprsetr_find_guides
tools.description: Find Coprsetr's source-linked guides to compliance, privacy, security and trust (no account needed), by words, topic or region: SOC 2, ISO 27001, GDPR, FedRAMP, PCI DSS, HIPAA and more. Returns the guide's name, what it is, how many steps it has and a link. Not legal advice. [Read]

query.description: Words to find a guide by, e.g. SOC 2 or customer security questionnaire.

topic.description: Only one topic, e.g. privacy or security.

tools.name: coprsetr_get_guide
tools.description: One Coprsetr guide as a step-by-step roadmap (no account needed): who it applies to, the outcome, the timeline, every step with its owner, timing, action and deliverables, and the official sources. Not legal advice or an audit. [Read]

tools.name: cloudverg_list_services
tools.description: Cloudverg's fixed-price services (no account needed): name, what it is for, published price, billing unit and how long it takes, by category. [Read · cloudverg.com]

category.description: A category slug, e.g. cloud, security, ai, software.

tools.name: cloudverg_get_service
tools.description: One Cloudverg service in full (no account needed): who it is for, what you get, the steps, common questions and today's price. [Read · cloudverg.com]

tools.name: suddengone_after_death_checklist
tools.description: The steps after someone dies (no account needed), grouped by when they matter: the first days, the first weeks, and the months after, each with a short note and a link. [Read]

tools.name: suddengone_account_after_death
tools.description: What happens to one online account when its owner dies (no account needed): Google, Apple, Facebook, Instagram, Microsoft, PayPal and more. The service's own legacy tool and its steps, what happens without a plan, and what to write down now. [Read]

service.description: The service, e.g. google, apple, facebook.

tools.name: suddengone_get_guide
tools.description: One of SuddenGone's guides on preparing for or handling a death (no account needed), by slug or by words. [Read]

query.description: Words to find a guide by.

tools.name: erpsav_define_term
tools.description: What an accounts payable or finance term means (no account needed): definition, formula, a worked example and the points that matter, e.g. three-way match, DPO, duplicate payment. [Read · erpsav.com]

tools.name: erpsav_payment_terms
tools.description: What a payment term means (no account needed), e.g. 2/10 net 30 or EOM: when payment is due, the early-payment discount and the annual rate that discount is worth. [Read · erpsav.com]

tools.name: erpsav_recovery_playbook
tools.description: ERPSav's playbook for recovering money a business already lost (no account needed): duplicate payments, vendor credits, lease charges, card fees, warranty claims and more, with the steps. [Read · erpsav.com]
